app.name: Kinlock
app.tagline: Money that can only reach the school or landlord it was meant for.

common.notImplemented: This page is not built yet.
common.usdOnlyNote: No reliable exchange rate is available for this currency, so only the USD amount is shown.
common.rateRiskNote: Exchange rates change. The local-currency amount is an estimate and is not guaranteed.

request.title: Create a payment request
request.intro: Create a link that fills in the sender's form with your details, the amount and the payment schedule.
request.noAuthority: The link only fills in the form. It can't move money: the sender still reviews and signs everything.
request.payeeNone: No verified payees are available right now.
request.indexerDown: The list of payees can't be loaded right now. Try again in a minute.
request.referenceHint: For example an invoice or student number. Anyone with this link can see it; on chain it is stored only as a hash.
request.errorAmount: Check the amounts: use numbers like 150 or 150.25, with at most 7 decimals.
request.errorDate: Choose a date for every payment.
request.errorOrder: Payments must be in date order.
request.errorGeneric: The link couldn't be created. Check the details and try again.
